The executed code used derived seeds SEED+1/SEED+2 (20260821/20260822), yielding 0.7584 (dev) and 0.8902 (hist) - the 0.7529 reproduction claim did NOT hold verbatim because that number requires the original gate_A seed 20260808 (verified: 20260808 -> 0.7529 exactly; 20260821 -> 0.7584 exactly).
